# Health Economics

> Rust crate of pure calculation functions for health-economics metrics —
> health outcome measures, economic evaluation frameworks, decision rules,
> uncertainty analysis, healthcare operations, digital health products, AI
> evaluation, and their software-engineering analogues. Almost entirely
> `f64` in, `f64`/`Option<f64>` out; three modules use the `rusty_money`
> crate for exact-decimal currency arithmetic (this crate's only
> dependency).

One module per metric topic, each mirroring a topic in the upstream
[Health Economics Metrics](https://github.com/healthprojects/health-economics-metrics)
project: what the metric is, how it's calculated, why it matters, a worked
example that runs as a doctest, the software engineering connection,
common pitfalls, and further reading.

## Docs

- [Crate root](src/lib.rs): module index and a quickstart doctest
- [Specification contracts](spec/README.md): formula, signature, and
  `None`/`Err` condition for every function — the single source of truth
  for "what it computes"
- [README](README.md): install, quickstart, module index, testing
- [Skill](health-economics-skill/SKILL.md): how an AI agent should pick a
  function and read `Option<f64>` results in this crate
- [Tutorials](docs/tutorials/): four long-form guides from a waiting-list
  business case through to the software-engineering mirror

## Modules

### Health outcome measures

- [Quality-Adjusted Life Year (QALY)](src/quality_adjusted_life_year.rs): `qalys`, `qaly_loss_from_delay`, `qaly_gain`, `population_qalys`, `monetized_value`, `discount_factor`
- [EQ-5D](src/eq_5d.rs): `qalys`, `qaly_gain`, `attributable_qaly_gain`, `monetized_value`
- [Disability-Adjusted Life Year (DALY)](src/disability_adjusted_life_year.rs): `years_of_life_lost`, `years_lived_with_disability`, `dalys`, `cost_per_daly_averted`, `who_choice_band`
- [Life-Years Gained (LYG)](src/life_years_gained.rs): `life_years_gained_from_deaths_prevented`, `life_years_gained_from_mean_survival`, `area_between_survival_curves`, `qalys_from_life_extension`, `evlyg_from_life_extension`, `monetary_value`
- [Health-Adjusted Life Expectancy (HALE)](src/health_adjusted_life_expectancy.rs): `proportion_in_full_health`, `sullivan_hale`, `hale_gap`, `hale_contribution_per_person`, `years_to_days`
- [Patient-Reported Outcomes (PROMs, PREMs, MCID)](src/patient_reported_outcomes.rs): `instrument_sum_score`, `distribution_based_mcid`, `adjusted_difference`, `clears_mcid`, `absolute_risk_reduction`, `number_needed_to_treat`, +4 more
- [Number Needed to Treat (NNT)](src/number_needed_to_treat.rs): `absolute_risk_reduction`, `relative_risk_reduction`, `number_needed_to_treat`, `number_needed_to_harm`, `cost_per_event_prevented`, `prevention_payoff_ratio`
- [Work Productivity and Activity Impairment (WPAI)](src/work_productivity_and_activity_impairment.rs): `absenteeism_percent`, `overall_work_impairment_percent`, `productivity_cost`

### Economic evaluation frameworks

- [Cost-Effectiveness Analysis (CEA)](src/cost_effectiveness_analysis.rs): `icer`, `average_cost_effectiveness_ratio`, `incremental_icers`
- [Cost-Utility Analysis (CUA)](src/cost_utility_analysis.rs): `total_qalys`, `delta_qalys`, `displaced_care_saving`, `icur`, `is_dominant`
- [Cost-Benefit Analysis (CBA)](src/cost_benefit_analysis.rs): `discount_factor`, `annuity_factor`, `present_value`, `net_present_value`, `benefit_cost_ratio`, `optimism_bias_cost_uplift`, +1 more
- [Cost-Minimization Analysis (CMA)](src/cost_minimization_analysis.rs): `outcomes_equivalent`, `cost_minimization`, `cost_saving`
- [Cost-Consequence Analysis (CCA)](src/cost_consequence_analysis.rs): `cost_per_unit_gained`, `value_of_avoided_events`
- [Budget Impact Analysis (BIA)](src/budget_impact_analysis.rs): `net_cost_per_patient`, `scenario_cost`, `budget_impact`
- [Social Return on Investment (SROI)](src/social_return_on_investment.rs): `total_outcome_value`, `sroi_ratio`, `value_after_drop_off`, `proxy_valued_share`
- [Health Technology Assessment (HTA)](src/health_technology_assessment.rs): `icer`, `meets_threshold`, `probability_cost_effective`, `recommend_routine_commissioning`
- [Human Capital Approach vs Friction Cost Method](src/human_capital_and_friction_cost.rs): `human_capital_cost`, `friction_cost`
